title: What's new
blurb: The gift in the sidebar header lists what shipped, newest release first, and carries a dot until you have read it.

title: Sessions outlive the GUI
blurb: A small daemon owns the terminals. Quit, crash, update — your agents keep working.

title: Every agent
blurb: Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Aider, Pi, OpenCode, or a plain shell. One launcher (⌘T).

title: Grid view
blurb: ⌘G shows a project, ⇧⌘G shows everything. Arrow keys move between tiles spatially.

title: Git worktrees
blurb: ⇧⌘T spawns an agent in its own worktree. Hive refuses to delete one with unpushed work.

title: Know who needs you
blurb: A bell becomes a pulse and a desktop notification. ⌘B jumps to the agent waiting on you.

title: Undo a close
blurb: ⌘Z reopens a closed session — name, project, worktree and, where the agent supports it, the conversation.

title: Multi-window
blurb: ⇧⌘N opens another window on the same daemon.

title: 17 themes
blurb: Hive dark and light, native, terminal, plus Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night, Catppuccin, Solarized and more. ANSI palette included.

title: In-app updates
blurb: Release or latest-commit channel. Nothing downloads until you press Update. macOS only for now.

title: Scrollback across daemon restart
blurb: Today scrollback lives with the daemon process.

title: Signed and notarized builds
blurb: Release zips are SHA-256 verified but not yet signed.
